_doc: ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA — the business intent side of traceability.
Each spec in specs.js declares the `ac` it covers, so the matrix reads
intent -> acceptance criterion -> test -> evidence -> verdict.
AC-6 deliberately has NO covering test. That is a real coverage gap, and the gate
reports it rather than hiding it: an acceptance criterion with no test is the honest
definition of missing coverage, and it is what stops generated test suites from
padding themselves with rows that trace to nothing.

criteria.text: A shopper can navigate to their cart from any page.
Adding a product places it in the cart.
The order total must equal subtotal minus discount plus tax.
The promo code SAVE10 reduces the subtotal by 10%.
Accepting the terms and submitting places the order.
A shopper can remove a single line item from the cart.
